title: Helios Order Visibility
summary: Supplier confirmations and customer order tracking for ERPNext
long_description: Supplier PO confirmation uses an expiring signed link or a constrained email reply. Confirmations write the decision and schedule date to the Purchase Order and its open lines. Customer links expose a filtered Sales Order or Delivery Note snapshot. The Supplier OTD Script Report and late-lines workspace shortcut help purchasing teams act on overdue lines.
